### Workflow Sweep example (SDXL)
Needs: `sd_xl_base_1.0.safetensors`

The Builder holds a Workflow Sweep array: an embedded API-format SDXL graph with cfg, sampler and prompt axes. Export any of your own workflows with 'Export (API)' and load it in the Builder's Workflow Sweep section to grid-test graphs the standard arrays cannot express. See `examples/README.md`.
